title: Epoch Residential — claimed by spacebears
description: US · Hospitality · Epoch Residential (Epoch Management, Inc.) — US private multifamily real estate developer, builder and property manager, Winter Park, Florida. Founded 1970. Vertically integrated: land acquisition, development, construction, asset and property management, investor relations. Builds Class-A garden, mid-rise and townhome communities plus active-adult (55+) housing across Sunbelt and Southeast suburb
